exclusion_detail: The abstract names no lead; by the fallback rule the lead is 6e (the pregnenolone ester, the most cytotoxic and the only one taken to flow cytometry). Its precursor THP ether of hepta-5,6-dien-1-ol is made from hex-5-yn-1-ol 'by a reported procedure [20-22]' and the cyclomagnesiation/Jones oxidation to diacid 4 'according to known procedures [23]', with no procedure in the paper; with the allene preparation the chain would also exceed 4 reactions.

lead.label: 6e
lead.why: Not named in the abstract; text: 'Compound 6e was the most active inhibitor of the HEK293, Jurkat, and K562 tumor cell growth' and acid 6e was the sole compound taken to the flow cytometry (apoptosis) follow-up.

notes: Only the final DCC/DMAP esterification (steroid 5e = pregnenolone, commercial, + diacid 4) has a described transformation, and even there the experimental gives only product data for 6a-g; the preceding steps are by citation only.
